Python3-H002 Strings
Strings - Index



Strings are treated as contiguous set of characters. Strings can be enclosed in single or double quotes.

The index starts from zero. Hence to print the first character of the string name, we use the code name[0]
name = input()
print(name[0])

 

ProgramID- 2769  SKILLRACK

Print 2nd Character



Complete the program so that it prints the 2nd character of the input string value. (Assume the input length will be more than 2).
